## Before Class

You should have:

- R + RStudio installed ([Instructions](/assignments/install-R.html))
- Quarto installed ([Instructions](/assignments/01_quarto.html))

## Get Your GitHub Account Ready

Create a GitHub account if you don't have one yet:

1. Go to [github.com](https://github.com/)
2. Click "Sign up" and follow the instructions
3. Post your GitHub username to Slack

We'll use GitHub later in the course for version control and hosting your final project.
